antiDoubleCountingRules: Price aggregate token counts only; never aggregate + modality-specific subtotal (Gemini image input is folded into promptTokenCount AND broken out non-additively).
Streaming: take usage from the final cumulative chunk exactly once; never sum per-chunk cumulative entries.
Reasoning/thoughts tokens are folded into totalTokenCount; never add a separate reasoning charge.
Cache hits (identify) must produce zero usage and zero cost.
Voice must report audio-understanding and TTS usage as distinct entries; do not merge or drop either.
Multi-call chat turns must attribute each call's usage to its own actual model.
usageAccounting.streamingSemantics: Gemini usageMetadata is cumulative (EVERY_EVENT_CUMULATIVE per usage baseline); current per-chunk recording + summing is unsafe

notes: Grounding with Google Search: 5000 free requests/month across Gemini 3.x, then $14/1000 requests

recommendations: Fix stream usage to last-chunk-only semantics; never sum cumulative per-chunk entries.
Report voice audio-understanding and TTS usage as distinct entries; do not discard TTS usage.
Attribute each chat call's usage to its own actual model; emit perCall array when a turn makes multiple provider calls.
Materialize provider-neutral rate cards (integer micros) from the baseline; reconcile the stale telemetry fallback prices (gemini-3.6-flash and gemini-3.5-flash-lite understate vs baseline).
Populate google_gemini entries in ai-model-capabilities.json; add TTS model pricing/usage baseline entries.
Extract a googleGeminiAdapter behind the canonical usage contract; keep generic pricing free of provider strings.
Keep fixed Wallet prices unchanged; keep usage-based durable billing dormant until Phases 1-3 pass acceptance.
Surface request id via the adapter when the SDK exposes it (langfuse/otel may be the source).
